subject: Access controls & support access — post-call recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@fintrustbank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Access controls & support access — post-call recap

Hi Emily — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned.

Key notes from today:
- Primary concerns: PII handling, retention windows, detailed access controls (RBAC), and emergency/support access (break-glass).
- Data residency: FinTrust prefers US-only region for production data; testing in us-west is acceptable.
- Logging/monitoring: you want audit-level logs for support actions and admin role changes for 1 year.

What Redwood provides today (high level):
- RBAC: role-based roles + custom roles; least-privilege defaults; supports attribute-based filters for multi-tenant orgs.
- Support access: time-limited, just-in-time access with follow-up audit events; break-glass requires two approvers for elevated access and generates an automated incident record.
- Audit & retention: configurable audit retention up to 3 years; token-level logs with export to S3 or your SIEM.
- Data residency: we can pin production workloads to our us-west region and restrict backups accordingly.

Open items / next steps (owner):
1) Share our RBAC matrix and support-access runbook (attached) — Marissa (done).
2) FinTrust to confirm minimum required log retention period and any export/format requirements — Emily (action).
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive with your security engineer and our infra lead (30–45m) — Rishi to lead scheduling.
4) Send over your completed security questionnaire answers where possible; we can pre-fill some responses — Emily / security team.

Attachments: Redwood-RBAC-Controls.pdf (RBAC matrix & policies), MAAPQ-template.xlsx (we completed the first tab; attached as FinTrust-MAAPQ-completed.xlsx).

If that matches your understanding, could you confirm the log retention requirement and a couple of available times for a technical follow-up?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0162
From: Emily Chen <emily@fintrustbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FinTrust Security <security@fintrustbank.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access controls & support access — post-call recap

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and for sending the attachments. A few clarifications from our side:

- Log retention: minimum 12 months for audit trails; we prefer immutable exports to S3 on a weekly cadence.
- RBAC: we need to confirm whether Redwood can map to our internal directory groups (AD) and support custom role templates for 10–12 named roles. Can support access be scoped to :read-only, :diagnostic, and :full-support?
- Break-glass: the requirement is a documented process with two independent approvers and an email/Slack notification to our on-call. The approval trail needs to be tamper-evident.
- SOC2 / evidence: please attach SOC2 report or tell us where we can download our compliance pack.

Next steps: I’ll circulate the retention requirement to security and get back by Friday. Can we target a technical deep-dive next week? Thursday or Friday AM (PST) works.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Chen
Information Security, FinTrust Bank
emily@fintrustbank.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@fintrustbank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access controls & support access — post-call recap

Thanks Emily — really helpful. A few direct answers and confirmations below.

On RBAC and AD mapping:
- We support SAML/SCIM for AD group-sync; we can map your AD groups to Redwood roles (we’ve done this with several banks).
- Role templates: we can create up to 20 custom role templates; each template can be limited by action (read, write, admin) and by resource namespace.
- Scope options: yes, we can support the three-tier support scopes you listed (:read-only, :diagnostic, :full-support). We’ll include that in the RBAC matrix.

Support access & break-glass:
- Break-glass process: request → automated approval request to two designated approvers → ephemeral grant (max TTL configurable, recommended 4 hours) → automatic revocation and audit entry. All actions are logged and exportable.
- Tamper-evidence: audit records are signed and stored with integrity checks; we can export hash-summaries to your S3 for cross-checking.

Logging & retention:
- We can do immutable weekly exports to your S3 bucket and retain audit logs within Redwood for 12–36 months depending on the plan.

Compliance artifacts:
- SOC 2 report and security pack: https://redwoodinference.com/compliance (we will also send the packaged SOC2 report via secure link).

Attachments: I re-attached the RBAC matrix (Redwood-RBAC-Controls.pdf) and the MAAPQ answers (FinTrust-MAAPQ-completed.xlsx).

Proposed next step: Rishi and Sean will run a 45m technical deep-dive to demo role mapping and the support-access flow. Rishi — can you propose two slots next week (Thu/Fri AM PST)? Emily — once you confirm, we’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

Best,
Marissa
